guides.content.stuck-in-space.title: Stuck in Space
guides.content.stuck-in-space.subtitle: A chain of spatial bubbles at Rosstan: reach Lyokha Strizh and get back out.
guides.content.stuck-in-space.intro.p1: At Rosstan a stalker got trapped in a chain of spatial bubbles. To reach him and get back out, you need to jump from one bubble to the next in sequence.
guides.content.stuck-in-space.intro.p2: Bring any detector — without it you cannot take the quest.
guides.content.stuck-in-space.step1.text: Continue the dialogue chain until a new task appears.
guides.content.stuck-in-space.step2.text: From the main bubble head northwest. At the edge of the slope you will see the bubble you need — jump into it.
guides.content.stuck-in-space.step2.capt: Bubble at the edge of the slope — entry point
guides.content.stuck-in-space.step3.text: As soon as you appear in the new place, again move northwest — you will find the second bubble there.
guides.content.stuck-in-space.step4.text: You will be teleported into a radiation field. To avoid taking too much radiation at once, immediately run north — the third bubble is there.
guides.content.stuck-in-space.step4.capt: Exit from the radiation field — third bubble
guides.content.stuck-in-space.step5.text: As soon as you appear, immediately run along the wooden boards to the right into the next bubble, or you will have to deal with a pack of psy-dogs.
guides.content.stuck-in-space.step5.capt: Wooden bridge and the bubble on the right
guides.content.stuck-in-space.step6.text: As soon as you appear, look around first. You need to parkour across the stone pillars to the very end — there you will see the next bubble.
guides.content.stuck-in-space.step6.capt: Stone pillars — route to the bubble
guides.content.stuck-in-space.step7.text: Final bubble: after appearing on the smoke stack catwalk, turn 180° and walk to the bubble. It is marked on the minimap.
guides.content.stuck-in-space.step7.capt: Smoke stack catwalk and the final bubble
guides.content.stuck-in-space.step8.text: You will be teleported straight to the stalker — Lyokha Strizh. Talk to him.
guides.content.stuck-in-space.step8.capt: Lyokha Strizh trapped in the spatial bubble
guides.content.stuck-in-space.step9.text: Turn toward the bubble you are in and interact with it.
guides.content.stuck-in-space.step10.tex: After receiving the quest artifact Compass, talk to Lyokha Strizh again.
guides.content.stuck-in-space.step11.tex: Finish the dialogue and claim the quest reward.
guides.content.rf-receiver.title: RF receiver: stash hunting
guides.content.rf-receiver.subtitle: How to set a frequency, follow the signal sound and claim stash loot.
guides.content.rf-receiver.overview.p1: The RF receiver is a detector for finding stashes by radio frequency. You can get it from technician Mastak at Junkyard or use one you already have.
guides.content.rf-receiver.overview.p2: Once equipped, the receiver beeps: the closer the stash, the faster and louder the signal. Location frequencies can be copied on the wiki homepage.
guides.content.rf-receiver.overview.capt: RF receiver in the detector slot
guides.content.rf-receiver.setup.p1: Place the receiver in the detector slot and take it in your hands. In inventory right-click the device, turn it on and enter the frequency for your target location.
guides.content.rf-receiver.setup.card1.t: The detector slot is required — the device won't activate without it.
guides.content.rf-receiver.setup.card2.t: Location frequencies can be copied on the wiki homepage in the RF receiver block.
guides.content.rf-receiver.setup.tip: The green indicator should stay lit, not blink — that's a sign of correct setup.
guides.content.rf-receiver.setup.caption: Powering on the receiver and entering a frequency
guides.content.rf-receiver.hunting.p1: Walk toward stronger sound. Faster beeping means you're closer to the stash point. A loot crate will appear on site.
guides.content.rf-receiver.hunting.li2: You are in the correct location
guides.content.rf-receiver.loot.p1: Carry the crate to a safe zone to open it and claim the contents. Loot varies by location and may change with updates.
guides.content.rf-receiver.loot.caption: Stash crate after discovery
